import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Unbundled.RingSeminorm
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.AbsoluteValue

import Mathlib.RingTheory.Polynomial.Basic
import Mathlib.Data.Finsupp.Weight
import Mathlib.Data.List.Indexes
#check_failure Roth.coeff_kronecker
namespace CoeffKroneckerHom
open MvPolynomial
#check @Polynomial.toFinsuppIsoAlg
#check @AddMonoidAlgebra.mapDomainAlgHom
#check @MvPolynomial.algHom_ext
theorem hom_bridge {R σ : Type*} [CommSemiring R] (w : σ → ℕ) :
    (Polynomial.toFinsuppIsoAlg R).toAlgHom.comp
      (aeval (fun j ↦ (Polynomial.X : Polynomial R) ^ w j)) =
        AddMonoidAlgebra.mapDomainAlgHom R R (Finsupp.weight w) := by
  apply MvPolynomial.algHom_ext
  intro i
  simp only [AlgHom.comp_apply, MvPolynomial.aeval_X]
  simp [MvPolynomial.X, MvPolynomial.monomial,
    AddMonoidAlgebra.mapDomain_single, AddMonoidAlgebra.mapDomainAlgHom,
    AddMonoidAlgebra.mapDomainRingHom, Finsupp.weight_single,
    Polynomial.toFinsuppIsoAlg]
#print axioms hom_bridge
end CoeffKroneckerHom
